mentions.name: 6502 Assembly Programmer's Calculator
mentions.description: A programmer's calculator designed as a companion for legacy computer programming, geared toward the kinds of calculations needed when writing 6502 assembly language, and styled with the C-64 palette of colours.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a programmer's calculator specifically as a companion for legacy computer programming. It's geared toward the kind of calculations a person might need when writing 6502 assembly language. It even uses the C-64 palette of colours.
